senses.gloss: (Pilp. of דרר, v. Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. I, p. 444ᵃ); Hithpalp. הִדַּרְדֵּר to roll.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:11">Cant. R. to VI, 11</cite> <he>כולן מִדַּרְדְּרִין ומתגלגלין</he> all of them get in commotion and roll (<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 11:1">Pesik. R. s. 11</cite> <he>מתרעמין ומרגישין</he>). V. <cite ref="D01045"><he>דַּרְדּוּר</he></cite>.
